# BhuRakshak — Autonomous Landslide Early Warning System

> AI-powered landslide prediction and citizen alert platform for India's Northeast

## Overview
BhuRakshak is a real-time geological hazard monitoring system that combines
machine learning (XGBoost/LightGBM ensemble), geotechnical sensor telemetry,
and automated NDMA-protocol citizen alert dispatch to predict and warn about
landslide events in India's Northeastern states (Sikkim, West Bengal,
Meghalaya, Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh).

## Key Features
- Real-time district-level landslide probability estimation
- Factor of Safety (FoS) computation from soil, rainfall, and slope data
- Self-training ML model with automated performance ledger
- Multi-channel email alert dispatch (Google Webhook, Resend, SMTP)
- Citizen registration and subscription system
- Explainable AI (XAI) with SHAP feature importance
- Interactive GeoJSON hazard map with Leaflet

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, Leaflet
- Backend: FastAPI (Python), SQLAlchemy, SQLite
- ML: XGBoost, LightGBM, scikit-learn
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Render (backend)
